correctness.rationale: The greedy embedding equivalence D<=k-1 is exact. Minimality forces D=k with descending endpoint edges and the interior triple identity. Ascents induce strictly increasing edges in both step-two parity tracks; each track needs at least ceil(a/(q-1))-1 nonincreases. With k-a-1 nonincreases total this yields the sharp upper bound, attained for each allowed a by concatenated doubled staircases and extra initial zeros. The bounded literal verifier passed 14 host cases/65958 candidate strings and separate finite-state maxima passed 136 cases; finite cases corroborate rather than prove the infinite result.

value.rationale: For a natural host family B_k already central in the literature on exponentially many MAS, gives the exact upper cutoff and every attainable MAS length uniformly for arbitrary q>=4 and k>=1, including nontrivial slope 2q/(q+1). The two parity tracks show the structural obstruction, and explicit doubled staircases provide sharp constructions. This is not a mere recoding of a binary/ternary special case or a single arbitrary finite instance.
